name: rocketeye-functions
description: RocketEye Firebase backend (round issuing, server-authoritative scoring, leaderboards).

scripts.serve: npm run build && firebase emulators:start --only auth,firestore,functions,hosting --project rockketeyes
scripts.smoke: npm run build && cd .. && firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore,functions --project rockketeyes "node functions/scripts/smoke.mjs"
